global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling noodles, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and a delicate naruto fish cake. The white bowl sits on a dark surface, softly lit to highlight the steamy, inviting meal.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, slightly reflective surface curves gently around the bowl's base, showing subtle wood grain texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, spinach, and chashu pork slice, glossy surface reflecting light.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and faint water droplets visible.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale meat with visible fat marbling and a slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with curved, segmented shapes and faint fibrous texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pink swirl center, scalloped edges, smooth surface with subtle sheen.
